title: Kammlerstab Nazi tech transfer to Wright Field

tellings.quote: there's actually a secret kind of weapons facility in Czechoslovakia in Modern Day Poland run by SS officer Hans commer

plain: During the Second World War, the story goes, an SS officer named Hans Kammler ran a secret weapons facility in Czechoslovakia, which Michels places in "modern day Poland," and its technology later passed to Wright Field, the American military aircraft research base. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode asking whether Oppenheimer worked on UFOs; if true, some of America's secret aerospace work would have Nazi roots.
